name: Curve/Vyper reentrancy exploits (pETH, msETH, alETH, CRV/ETH) - four pools, three races
era: post-merge, pre-mempool-dumpster (in-block evidence only; Flashbots-relay bid history available)
verdict_reason: Two auction tooling labels corrected (msETH 'reverted' tx; CRV/ETH 'post-hack trade'). Our call-level comparison for c0ffeebabe.eth transactions is withheld by policy; the public traces can be compared by anyone.
protocol_loss_usd: reported: ~$41M (DeFiHackLabs), $52M falling to $46.5M after c0ffeebabe's return (The Block quoting PeckShield), up to $73.5M in other outlets; on-chain pulls seen: pETH 6,106.65 WETH, msETH 866.73 ETH, alETH 7,258.70 ETH + ~4,821 alETH, CRV/ETH phase 2 2,879.66 ETH

eoas: 0x19c7849d10333188678fad560d2436cec11071a6 (msETH + CRV/ETH phase 2; copy of pETH code first)
attacker.note: the exploitation was done by at least four independent actors; two (alETH's 0xdce5d6b4 and the pETH front-runner) describe/are described as white hats and returned funds; per-pool details in sub_races[].original_attacker

sub_races.verdict_reason: A non-attacker address front-ran the real attacker inside the same block: its in-tx CREATE initcode equals the attacker's deploy-tx initcode byte for byte except one 20-byte address (attacker EOA -> front-runner's contract); front-runner at idx 0 (priority fee 18.28 gwei), attacker's deploy+attack at idx 90/91 (priority 0.15 gwei); the attacker's attack tx reverted.
sub_races.W3_claim_check: front-runner 0xa84aa065 at idx 0: CONFIRMED, but it is a front-runner (copy of the attacker's code), NOT the attacker. Reverted attempt 0xb5d91f at idx 91: CONFIRMED and it is the REAL attacker (fresh Tornado-funded EOA 0x172f6fde). 'returned 90%': CONFIRMED on-chain (5,495.4 of 6,106.75 WETH).

original_attacker.funding_tx: 0x56ca0a0cff2ac75906e8ab0ea406fa263fac6a0e68e0ddef521bfe04b35eed64 (block 17723782, 2023-07-18, 0.0889 ETH from Tornado Cash 0.1 ETH pool 0x12d66f87..., internal transfer)

txs.note: start() on his contract; Balancer flash 80,000 WETH -> add_liquidity 40,000 ETH -> remove_liquidity -> reentrant add_liquidity -> second remove_liquidity reverted

bots.label: pETH front-runner (not c0ffeebabe)

txs.raw_trace: Our call-level comparison for c0ffeebabe.eth transactions is withheld by policy; the public traces can be compared by anyone.

bots.notes: EOA existed since 2022 (167 prior txs, same contract 0x9420f882 used repeatedly); its ONLY txs touching the 4 Curve pools between 17793000 and 17806500 is this one (pooltouch_0x6ec21d18.json). Moved 6,106.75 WETH out of the contract to the EOA at 17806309, then 1.0 + 6,105.75 WETH to 0x9d1ec337 (17839894, 17839905, 2023-08-04), which sent 1.0 + 5,494.4 WETH to the JPEG'd Safe 0x51c2cef9 (17844527, 17844597, 2023-08-04T22:28Z); JPEG'd on-chain statement (17844761): 'receipt of 5,494.4 WETH back to the JPEG'd Multisig for a total of 5,495.4 WETH. A 10% white-hat bounty of 610.6 WETH was awarded'.

other_racers.note: 17806058 = 2 blocks after the attack; same entry selector 0xbe9a6555, same 80,000 WETH flash and 40,000 ETH add_liquidity amounts; initcode only ~25% similar to the attacker's (re-implementation)

other_racers.label: msETH actor's copy of the same initcode
other_racers.note: deployed 12 s (1 block) after the pETH attack with 52.4 gwei gas; identical to the pETH attacker's initcode except the 20-byte beneficiary address -> propagation of the attack code to the next copier within one block

auction.note: block 17806056 has no delivered-payload record on any reachable relay (winner not identifiable; extraData '@rsyncbuilder', fee recipient 0x1f9090aa..., last tx pays the proposer 94.72 ETH). The block's value is dominated by an UNRELATED 157.76 ETH coinbase payment at idx 1 (0xcf29332e -> 0x7d32c90762, an exchange() on the pETH pool right after the exploit). The front-runner won position 0 on a plain 18.28 gwei priority fee (0.0309 ETH to the builder) and kept 99.9995% of the 6,106.65 WETH - the opposite of Sushi: no auction capture.

messages.from: 0x7a271674 (JPEG'd team EOA, also called pause() on the pETH token at 17806593)
messages.text: We would appreciate if you could contact us as soon as possible to discuss a white hat bounty. ... The JPEG'd Team

We, the JPEG'd team ... formally assert that upon successful return of the funds to the JPEG'd DAO multisig: 1. Legal action will not be taken against the operator of the address 0x6Ec21d... and 0x9d1ec337... The entity controlling above addresses previously secured 6,106 WETH from the pETH/ETH pool in transaction 0xa84aa065...

The JPEG'd DAO confirms receipt of 5,494.4 WETH back to the JPEG'd Multisig for a total of 5,495.4 WETH. A 10% white-hat bounty of 610.6 WETH was awarded to the owner of the address that recovered funds from the pETH exploit.

sub_races.verdict_reason: The attacker's own boom() tx two blocks later round-tripped 10,000 WETH for zero profit. Our call-level comparison for c0ffeebabe.eth transactions is withheld by policy; the public traces can be compared by anyone.
sub_races.W3_claim_check: c0ffeebabe at idx 0 in 17806550: CONFIRMED. 'later same-sequence REVERTED tx 0xe2eb61b1 in 17806552': CORRECTED - the tx status is 1 (success); inside it the first add_liquidity (depth 3) and the reentrant one reverted, the flash loan was repaid, net zero. It is the ATTACKER/adapter (0x19c7849d), not a copycat of c0ffeebabe.

original_attacker.funding_tx: 0x5fbd45fddec6d8705bf78e4f364b2d7b90f7fa63d7bf471f0004c2830f1cccbc (block 17438879, 1.12 ETH from 0xdfd5293d..., ordinary EOA, not Tornado)
original_attacker.role_note: the same EOA first deployed a byte-for-byte copy of the pETH attacker's initcode at 17806057 (see pETH sub-race), then adapted it for msETH (4,902-byte initcode) and later for CRV/ETH (3,677-byte initcode): an opportunistic adapter, identity unknown

It was a white hat operation from the very beginning ... i writed code and test all ETH pools, i knew many others are doing the same thing ... so i need to beat them ... i think 20% ie 2400 ethers is a reasona[ble bounty]  (truncated at 400 chars in my extraction)

sub_races.verdict_reason: No racer: attacker deployed its contract at 17807829 idx 84 and attacked at 17807830 idx 6 (1 gwei priority); no other tx in 17807700-17808000 replays the sequence. Not front-run.
sub_races.W3_claim_check: tx 0x2e7dc8b2 (0xb752def3 -> 0x83e056ba) is the real CRV/ETH reentrancy attack (add_liquidity/remove_liquidity_one_coin loops, 10,000 WETH Balancer flash), not a post-hack trade.

sub_races.verdict_reason: Curve's deployer address wrote on-chain: 'One tx you front-ran was a hack of CRV/ETH pool'. Our call-level comparison for c0ffeebabe.eth transactions is withheld by policy; the public traces can be compared by anyone.
sub_races.W3_claim_check: 'post-hack trade 2.8 h later, label related-not-frontrun': REJECTED. The timing is right (17807830 -> 17808683 = 853 blocks, 2.84 h) but this is a second-wave attack on the pool's remaining funds and c0ffeebabe pre-empted a still-pending attacker deployment.

auction_summary.relays_that_answered_with_2023_bid_data: Flashbots only (Ultra Sound, Agnostic, bloXroute, Aestus, Titan, ETHGas, BTCS answered empty; Manifold, Eden, bloXroute max-profit/ethical, Blocknative unreachable)
auction_summary.headline: Unlike Sushi, nearly nothing went to builders: the pETH front-runner won position 0 for 0.031 ETH of priority fee on 6,106 WETH; c0ffeebabe paid 0.173 ETH (msETH) and 0 (CRV/ETH). The only auction money spent was the copiers' failed gas bids: 698 gwei (0x79310104, ~1.28 ETH), 52-55 gwei (0x19c7849d), 85 gwei.

w3_claims_checked: front-runner 0xa84aa065 at idx 0: CONFIRMED, but it is a front-runner (copy of the attacker's code), NOT the attacker. Reverted attempt 0xb5d91f at idx 91: CONFIRMED and it is the REAL attacker (fresh Tornado-funded EOA 0x172f6fde). 'returned 90%': CONFIRMED on-chain (5,495.4 of 6,106.75 WETH).

c0ffeebabe at idx 0 in 17806550: CONFIRMED. 'later same-sequence REVERTED tx 0xe2eb61b1 in 17806552': CORRECTED - the tx status is 1 (success); inside it the first add_liquidity (depth 3) and the reentrant one reverted, the flash loan was repaid, net zero. It is the ATTACKER/adapter (0x19c7849d), not a copycat of c0ffeebabe.

alETH exploit 0xb676d789 in 17806772: CONFIRMED idx 10, status ok, profit 7,258.70 ETH + alETH; 'any racer?': none found among pool-touching txs; txs that never reached the pool (early reverts) are not enumerable here.
tx 0x2e7dc8b2 (0xb752def3 -> 0x83e056ba) is the real CRV/ETH reentrancy attack (add_liquidity/remove_liquidity_one_coin loops, 10,000 WETH Balancer flash), not a post-hack trade.

'post-hack trade 2.8 h later, label related-not-frontrun': REJECTED. The timing is right (17807830 -> 17808683 = 853 blocks, 2.84 h) but this is a second-wave attack on the pool's remaining funds and c0ffeebabe pre-empted a still-pending attacker deployment.

headline_text: An unrelated address copied the pETH attacker's contract and landed at block position 0, ahead of the attacker's own deploy and attack at positions 90 and 91 (which reverted); it took 6,106.65 WETH and returned 90% to JPEG'd.

harmonized.verdict_reason: 0x6ec21d18 at idx 0 of 17806056 ran a byte-copy (20 bytes differ) of the attacker's CREATE initcode; the real attacker's tx at idx 91 reverted.
